ios.desc:
Tired of scrolling through endless podcast lists? StumbleCast works like a radio — pick a genre and start listening instantly. Swipe to discover new podcasts and internet radio stations. Every episode starts at a random point, just like changing the channel.  14 day free trial of all pro features which can be purchased for a one time fee of $6.99.  No ads ever.

No algorithms. No endless browsing. Just podcasts and radio, the way listening was meant to feel.

HOW IT WORKS
  - Pick a category like True Crime, Comedy, Sports, or History
  - An episode or radio station starts playing immediately
  - Swipe up to jump to something new
  - Hear something you love? Save it to your favorites

FEATURES
  - Instant playback — no searching required
  - Podcasts and internet radio stations in one app
  - Browse 20+ categories
  - Chromecast and AirPlay support
  - CarPlay integration for hands-free listening
  - Download episodes for offline playback
  - Create and share custom playlists

StumbleCast is for people who love audio but hate having to chose. Just open the app and start listening.

quotes.text: I built something similar but for podcasts.  Swipe up and jump into the middle of a podcast like tuning a radio.  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stumblecast/id6758248417
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Channel Surfer – Watch YouTube like it’s cable TV
